description: Send Lentra a proposal request in the person's name, as the contact form on lentrahub.com/contact does: Lentra replies within two business days with a measured layout, a product mix and both operating models. Only with the person's explicit go-ahead and their own details; they receive a confirmation email. Attach configuration_id to include the configured hub.

email.description: The person's email address, as they gave it. They will be emailed.

full_name.description: The person's full name, as they gave it.

message.description: Building notes: location, lobby, timing, questions.

person_confirmed.description: true only if the person explicitly asked you to do this in their name, with these details. Never infer it.

units.description: Homes, rooms, beds or desks in the building.
